name: need-to-know
description: Prove one fact (income >= 3x rent, age >= 18) without handing over your documents. HackHarvard 2026.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n portal,tenant,bank -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w landlord-portal" "npm run dev -w tenant-app" "npm run dev -w bank-signer"
